# jankmeter

Real-time performance monitoring toolbar for React apps.

## Install

npm install jankmeter

## Integration Methods

### React Component (recommended)
import { JankMeter } from 'jankmeter/react';
// Add <JankMeter /> anywhere in your component tree

### Vite Plugin
import { jankMeter } from 'jankmeter/vite';
// Add jankMeter() to your Vite plugins array

### Next.js (App Router)
import { JankMeter } from 'jankmeter/next';
// Add <JankMeter /> to your root layout

### Webpack Plugin
const { JankMeterWebpackPlugin } = require('jankmeter/webpack');
// Add new JankMeterWebpackPlugin() to your Webpack plugins array

### Programmatic API
import { init, destroy, getMetrics } from 'jankmeter';
init(); // Start monitoring
destroy(); // Stop monitoring
getMetrics(); // Get current metrics snapshot

## Configuration

interface JankMeterConfig {
  enabled?: boolean;        // default: true
  shortcut?: string;        // default: 'Ctrl+Shift+M'
  throttleMs?: number;      // DOM update interval, default: 500
  maxHistory?: number;      // sparkline data points, default: 60
  onMetrics?: (metrics: AllMetrics) => void;
}

## Metrics

- FPS: requestAnimationFrame rolling window (all browsers)
- Jank %: Dropped frames / expected frames + Long Animation Frames API (all browsers, enhanced in Chrome)
- Delay: Event Timing API, INP-style (Chrome 96+)
- Memory: performance.memory (Chrome only)
- Network: fetch/XHR instrumentation + PerformanceObserver (all browsers)
- React: bippy + DevTools hook (all browsers with React)
- Hydration: First commit timing from navigation start (all browsers with SSR)

## Severity Thresholds

- FPS: ≥55 good, ≥30 warn, <30 bad
- Jank: <5% good, ≤15% warn, >15% bad
- Delay: <100ms good, ≤300ms warn, >300ms bad
- Memory: <200MB good, ≤500MB warn, >500MB bad
- Network: ≤2 in-flight good, ≤5 warn, >5 bad
- Hydration: <100ms good, ≤500ms warn, >500ms bad

## Key Features

- Zero config — drop in and go
- Shadow DOM — styles never leak into your app
- Auto-calibrates — detects 60/90/120/144Hz displays
- Keyboard shortcut — Ctrl+Shift+M (or Cmd+Shift+M) to toggle
- Minimize to dot — severity-colored indicator
- Download — export metrics as JSON
- Production safe — conditional exports + runtime guard + sideEffects: false
- SSR safe — no-ops on the server
